prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE final square flat KODAK PORTRA 400 packaging-inspired cover for a camera app's 110px thumbnails, coordinated with an existing film-cover grid.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing PORTRA 400 cover to refine. Image 2 is a real 35mm Kodak Portra 400 multipack photograph and is the authority for packaging identity. Image 3 is the current app grid, provided ONLY for visual weight, paper finish, hierarchy and palette harmony. Output only ONE cover, never the grid or a product photograph.

Primary request: Refine the existing cover into a calm, premium, legible PRINTED PACKAGING FRONT that keeps the recognizable purple / Kodak yellow / red wordmark identity. Follow the real Portra packaging rather than inventing a decorative logo or borrowing Fujifilm graphics. The current thin title, huge technical footer, blotchy purple and floating 3D red ribbon must be improved.

Composition and hierarchy:
- Full bleed square, orthographic and absolutely flat, with two main horizontal color fields: upper 76% quiet blue-violet purple; bottom 24% warm Kodak yellow brand / technical footer. Clean straight boundary, no extra panels.
- The upper purple field is a refined deep blue-violet, approximately #66558F, with very faint broad smooth blue-violet curved printing bands inspired by the real pack (image 2). The bands are barely visible and must not reduce lettering contrast. No vivid magenta or electric lavender; distinguish this stock from the warmer C200 and the plum Pro 400H in image 3. Keep confident clear packaging color rather than muddy brown or gray.
- ONE dominant element: the exact name "PORTRA 400" in ivory-white, ONE line, optically centered in the upper field at approximately 47%-51% of full canvas height. Use the real package's clean elegant sans-serif lettering, with modestly heavier MEDIUM / SEMIBOLD weight for a 110px thumbnail. No ultra-bold, no italics, no serif, no thin/light weight. Both PORTRA and 400 form one continuous title at the same cap height. Width no more than 86% of canvas, side margins at least 7%. Cap height around 12%-14% of canvas. Keep generous uncluttered space around it. Do not enlarge 400 separately.
- A small ivory "135" at upper left x=7%, y=10%, cap height 3.5%. It is only a format marker.
- One very small authentic multilingual line below the name: "Film · Película · Filme · Pellicola", around y=61%, cap height at most 2.5%. Do not add marketing claims.
- The yellow footer has the real red Kodak wordmark at x=7%, y=83%, width about 25%, clean accurate familiar logotype, not a block K emblem, not generic uppercase lettering. Set "Professional" in small charcoal sans serif underneath it at y=91%, height 3.5%. This yellow brand strip and red Kodak wordmark follow the photographed real packaging.
- Tiny quiet charcoal technical data at the lower right in the yellow footer: "35mm · 36EXP" on one line and "ISO 400 · C-41" below it. Cap height only 2.4%-2.8%, safe right and bottom margins at least 7%. They must be dramatically smaller than in image 1. Left brand and right data must never touch.
- The old floating red ribbon is removed completely. It is not in the referenced real pack. No substitute ribbon, badge, seal, starburst, ornamental drawing, giant 400 footer or NEW banner.

Style / materials: matte printed cardstock, virtually invisible fine grain consistent with image 3. The purple and yellow should look evenly printed, not patchy or weathered. Warm ivory lettering and a muted golden Kodak yellow (around #EBC131) fit the existing family. Preserve a clean contemporary product finish, without fake aging. Smooth flat color fields; no glossy effects.

Constraints: single 1:1 square full bleed front artwork, 1024×1024. No perspective, no 3D box, no photographed background, no margins, border, drop shadow or rounded corners (the app adds rounding). No Fujifilm header, no FUJI wording, no JustShoot, no RAW, no sRGB, no arrows, no invented slogan or watermark.
Text verbatim: "135", "PORTRA 400", "Film · Película · Filme · Pellicola", "Kodak", "Professional", "35mm · 36EXP", "ISO 400 · C-41".
